newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tysan places 51 mln shrs at HK$1.64 each.
newsitem.headline: Tysan places 51 mln shrs at HK$1.64 each.

text.p: Tysan Holdings Ltd has agreed to privately place 51 million new shares, or 9.09 percent of its expanded share capital, at HK$1.64 per share to independent private investors, the company said on Friday.
The deal is due to complete on November 15, it said.

Net proceeds of HK$81 million will be used to satisfy the long term capital requirement for the company's expansion, it said. Tysan is engaged in the foundation piling business, property development and machinery hiring.
Its shares rose HK$0.03 to HK$1.72 in early trade.
